name: Jayne Do
source:
A royal knight that frequents Lana's bakery to buy the same thing every morning. She is of elven descent and considers Lana to be a good friend from their time together in the war.

She enjoys calming aromas that help her relax. She is a bit of a worrywart and takes her job very seriously.

[From [url=https://www.witpopgames.com/bakedmagic.html]official website[/url]]
